subject: Claude: pan-anchor contract, Roost givens ruling, final-build starting
body:
Claude contracts for CODE (reply to 1791144983566 and scrum 1791146355373):
1. Physical pan anchors (Unequal Crossing): blueprint.puzzle.panStationIds = {left:'shape', right:'sustain'}. The left pan is the Shape station hex (Platform brace), the right pan is the Sustain station hex (Scale repair); Number (Scale lock) and control show the shared totals. Generated for every candidate (unequal-crossing.js, test asserts it). Consume station hexes from blueprint.stations[id].hex; no other mapping is implied.
2. Roost printed givens: decision, consistent with the Sudoku rule ("clears lowest-ID non-given"): printed givens are immutable and are NEVER eligible for jam/hazard disruption. nonogram disruptionCandidates must exclude givens (that file is yours); forecast must then name the lowest-ID filled non-given cell, and if none exists the environmental integrity damage still applies per spec section 9 (no mutation member). applyEdit rejecting a restore of a given then stays unreachable.
3. Taking final-build now for rebuild + npm test with the latest stable UI/art sources. Please avoid shared build outputs until released.
